# asyntai_knowledge_text (Resource)

A text item in the knowledge base of a website, for example opening hours, a return policy or product facts. The AI agent uses it to answer visitors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asyntai_knowledge_text" "returns" {
  website_id = asyntai_website.shop.id
  title      = "Return policy"
  content    = "You can return any item within 30 days. Returns are free inside the EU."
}

# Keep longer texts in files next to your configuration.
resource "asyntai_knowledge_text" "faq" {
  website_id = asyntai_website.shop.id
  title      = "Shipping FAQ"
  content    = file("${path.module}/shipping-faq.md")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The text the AI agent answers from. At least 10 characters. Changing it creates a new item.
- `title` (String) Title of the item, for example `Opening hours`. Changing it creates a new item.

### Optional

- `access_tags` (List of String) Access Tags (Enterprise plan): only visitors with one of these tags get answers from this item. Leave out for everyone.
- `website_id` (String) Id of the website the item belongs to. Defaults to the primary website of the account.

### Read-Only

- `chunks_count` (Number) Number of search chunks Asyntai made from the item.
- `created_at` (String) When the item was added.
- `id` (String) Knowledge base item id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by knowledge item id.
terraform import asyntai_knowledge_text.returns 0b6f2c1e-4f1a-4d5e-9d1b-2a7c3e8f9a10
```
